pages.text: The two schools of magic lean on each other. A mage who ignores one will stall in the other.$(br2)$(li)Iron's $(l:magic/irons#ars_bond_inscription_table)Inscription Table$(/l) is bound with a Worn Notebook, and its $(l:magic/irons2#ars_bond_scroll_forge)Scroll Forge$(/l) is built around Source.

$(li)Amethyst steeped in Source, with lapis on a pedestal beside it, becomes $(l:magic/ars2#arcane_essence)Arcane Essence$(/l).$(li)Ars essences can etch Iron's runes.$(li)Ars's greater spell books ask for Iron's essence and ingots.
